entries.name: callsites
entries.detail: the bundle set carries its network call sites inventoried: 47 sites over 7 bundles — bun.js (fetch 3, websocket 0, beacon 0); cli.js (fetch 2, websocket 0, beacon 0); deno.js (fetch 3, websocket 0, beacon 0); devthink.umd.js (fetch 3, websocket 0, beacon 0); index.js (fetch 3, websocket 0, beacon 0); index.neutral.js (fetch 3, websocket 0, beacon 0); server.js (fetch 30, websocket 0, beacon 0)

entries.name: gates
entries.detail: every network capable path carries its policy gate: sendfetch of the http family guarded by fetchconsentcovers; opensocket of the net family guarded by socketgate; subscribesse of the net family guarded by socketgate; outbound rest calls of the web api family guarded by origincheck; the api key header of the net control family guarded by apikeyconsentgranted; the auth flow of the net control family guarded by authconsentgranted; the relay client of the bridge family guarded by serverbindgate; the gateway adapters of the llm family guarded by providervalid

entries.name: proxy
entries.detail: the proxy run covered the startup (negotiation, handshake, capability manifest), the recipe run (2 plan fixtures with the session round trip) and the dashboard render with zero outbound attempts

entries.name: optin
entries.detail: the sync and update checks stay opt in only: the sync settings answer the optinsync consent gate and the telemetry policy of the types carries its enabled false literal

entries.name: local
entries.detail: the crash and error reporting stays local only: the crash marking (crashinterrupted) and the log masking (masklogtext) answer from the local stores with no outbound reporting path
